FLG-007 cited S11 for the 'at least 10 posts' rule of thumb. In this register S11 is the Chefman dual-window product page; the rule of thumb is recorded in S19 (Associates application help). Citation corrected to S19; logged as FLG-038.

merge_with_main.merged_from: origin/main at f41ef98 (PRs #76 and #77 merged while this branch was open)
merge_with_main.how_conflicts_were_resolved: Nothing from main was discarded. main's registers, guides, Journal and decision board are kept as shipped; this session's rows were renumbered into main's id space (sources S24 and S26, flags FLG-041 to FLG-043, suggestions S-26 to S-29, questions Q-20 to Q-22, facts K-22 to K-25, discovery D-15 to D-18). Two of this session's proposals were folded into main's existing rows instead of duplicated: de-indexing into S-20, and the Special-Link field into option D of S-02.
merge_with_main.guides: This session drafted five guides. Four duplicated pages that had landed on main in the meantime (cleanup/dishwasher, thermometer labels versus how-to-read-a-listing, presets, holiday planning), so they were withdrawn and their first-hand material was merged into main's pages as new sections with their own sources and 'amended' notes; one guide, Sync Finish and Hi-Fry, is new. Shelf: 14 guides. Recorded as FLG-043.
merge_with_main.convergence: Three findings of this session turned out to be already fixed on main when the merge ran: the stray degree sign in P01's function list, the stale 'fifth link resolves to nothing' executive summary, and the unreproducible short-link fetches (main's FLG-036 and FLG-037). They are recorded here rather than re-filed as new flags.
merge_with_main.new_findings_after_merging: Cross-checking main's guides against its own source register found five more mis-citations of the same class this session had found on its base: four guides cite S22 (the FTC Endorsement Guides page) for Chefman specification figures, where the maker's page for RJ38-SQSS-8T is S23 and the matte-black High-Fry unit is S12; and the chicken-breast guide cites S11 and S23 inline without declaring them. Fixed, and the two new gate rules in section 3b of tools/verify.mjs are what catch this class from here on (FLG-042, S-29).
